Definition: from a derivative of G2904 (transposed); to be strong, i.e. (figuratively) steadfast (patient):--endure.
BiblicalUsage: Moses left Egypt behind and kept going because he was looking at the One no eye can see, and that steady looking carried him through fear of the king.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe endurance is not gritting my teeth but keeping my eyes on the God I cannot see.
RelatedEvents: The Exodus and the Red Sea
